newsitem.title: CHILE: Entel Chile top Chile telecom in August.
newsitem.headline: Entel Chile top Chile telecom in August.

text.p: Telecommunications company Entel Chile SA was the top carrier in August in Chile's competitive multicarrier long distance service, said the telecommunications subsecretariat Wednesday.
The figures showed Telex-Chile SA long-distance unit Chilesat's share of international calls falling to 12.67 percent in August from 14.53 percent in July.
CTC's international market share fell to 20.8 percent in August from 22.09 percent in July, while VTR's share rose to 10.95 percent from 8.98 percent in the same period.
